beats.text: You talked about running shoes once. By the next morning, the ads were already waiting.
So your phone must be listening, right?
Scientists tested over seventeen thousand apps. Not one was caught secretly recording your voice.
But one company did hide secret whistles in TV ads, sounds only your phone could hear.
And the real reason that ad found you is even creepier.
Your phone doesn't need to hear you at all. I decoded the four ways it finds you, in the full video. Tap the link.
